messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Kannada, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Requirements (ONE Markdown table): - Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] - In [Target Requirement], make comparative direction unambiguous and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Output: ONLY the table; no extra prose.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement (Kannada morphosyntax; comparative direction = none; 1‑line literal back‑translation check) | |-------------|----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | Nel | “in the middle of” – locative prepositional phrase introducing the central point | Use locative postposition **‑ನಲ್ಲಿ** with the noun “ಮಧ್ಯ” → **ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ**.
**Back‑translation:** “Midway” | | mezzo | “middle” – the central point of a span | Translate as the noun **ಮಧ್ಯ** in locative form **ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ** (as above).
**Back‑translation:** “midway” | | del | genitive “of the” linking road to life | Render with genitive case **‑ದ** on “ರಸ್ತೆ” → **ರಸ್ತೆಯ**.
**Back‑translation:** “of the” | | cammin | “road, path” – metaphor for life’s course | Translate as **ರಸ್ತೆ** (road) in genitive **ರಸ್ತೆಯ** (as above).
**Back‑translation:** “road” | | di | genitive “of” linking road to life | Use genitive **‑ದ** on “ಜೀವನ” → **ಜೀವನದ**.
**Back‑translation:** “of” | | nostra | “our” – collective possession | Use possessive pronoun **ನಮ್ಮ** preceding the noun.
**Back‑translation:** “our” | | vita | “life” – span of existence | Translate as **ಜೀವನ** in genitive **ಜೀವನದ** (as above).
**Back‑translation:** “life” | | mi | reflexive pronoun “myself” (object) | Use reflexive pronoun **ನನ್ನನ್ನು** as object of the verb.
**Back‑translation:** “myself” | | ritrovai | “found” – self‑realization of location | Use past tense verb **ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ** (found/discovered).
**Back‑translation:** “found” | | per | preposition “within/through” indicating interior location | Use locative postposition **‑ನಲ್ಲಿ** after “ಕಾಡು” → **ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ**.
**Back‑translation:** “within” | | una | indefinite article “a” (non‑specific) | Kannada lacks articles; omit but keep noun singular.
**Back‑translation:** “a” | | selva | “forest, wood” – densely wooded area | Translate as **ಕಾಡು** (forest) in locative **ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ** (as above).
**Back‑translation:** “wood” | | oscura | “dark” – lacking light, gloomy | Use adjective **ಕತ್ತಲೆ** placed before noun in attributive position → **ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡು**.
**Back‑translation:** “dark” | | ché | conjunction “for, because” introducing causal clause | Use causal conjunction **ಏಕೆಂದರೆ**.
**Back‑translation:** “for” | | la | definite article “the” (feminine singular) | Omit article; Kannada marks definiteness via context.
**Back‑translation:** “the” | | diritta | “right, straight” – correct or proper | Translate as **ಸರಿಯಾದ** (correct) preceding “ಮಾರ್ಗ”.
**Back‑translation:** “right” | | via | “way, road” – the path that should be followed | Translate as **ಮಾರ್ಗ** (path) in nominative.
**Back‑translation:** “way” | | era | imperfect “was” – past state of being | Use past tense copula **ಇತ್ತು**.
**Back‑translation:** “had been” | | smarrita | “missed, lost” – state of being absent | Use past participle adjective **ಕಳೆದುಹೋದ** (lost) agreeing with feminine noun **ಮಾರ್ಗ** → **ಕಳೆದುಹೋದ ಮಾರ್ಗ**.
**Back‑translation:** “missed” |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Create placeable Kannada components for Step 4. Output ONLY bullet list; ONE LINE per bullet. - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Where <ID> is the leading integer at the start of the source line. Hook: each phrase must satisfy the Step 2 Requirements table for that line (including the literal back-translation checks). Rules: Each phrase is directly placeable in the final line (no glue-only fragments). Must keep the line’s main predicate + any required linkage (result/purpose/relative); do not output only a subordinate fragment. Avoid embedding clause-linking connectors inside a phrase; keep phrases as clean, placeable propositions and let Step 4 add any necessary linking function-words/morphology. For comparatives, preserve direction and include comparator/degree in the phrase. No punctuation characters inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 1: ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ / ಜೀವನದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರ್ಗ / ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಪಥ - Line 2: ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ / ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿದೆ / ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲೇ ತಾನೇ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ - Line 3: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದಿತ್ತು / ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪಥ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದಿತ್ತು / ಸರಿಯಾದ ರಸ್ತೆ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದಿತ್ತು

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Assemble Step3 components into Kannada lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 Final Form as contiguous substrings; reorder within-line as needed. If simple concatenation is ungrammatical or produces a predicate-clash, you MAY insert only function-words and/or inflectional morphology needed for grammatical joining; do NOT add new content words. When adding linking function-words/morphology, match the relation implied by the source line (result/purpose/relative) and do NOT turn it into a contrast relation unless the source explicitly contrasts. Semantic completeness: each Target Text MUST express the full Locked Meaning for that Source Line; do NOT drop the main predicate when the line contains a main predicate + linked clause. Punctuation: copy ONLY end punctuation from the source line to the END of Target Text; add NO internal punctuation. For each source line output ONLY this block (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary phrase from Step 3: re-insert it (no new content words).

Source Line: 1 Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita Line Inventory: - ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ Assembly Notes: - No additional function words needed; phrase directly matches the prepositional phrase. Target Text: ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ
Source Line: 2 mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, Line Inventory: - ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲೇ ತಾನೇ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ Assembly Notes: - No extra function words; retained the comma from the source line. Target Text: ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲೇ ತಾನೇ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ,
Source Line: 3 ché la diritta via era smarrita. Line Inventory: - ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದಿತ್ತು Assembly Notes: - Added causal conjunction “ಏಕೆಂದರೆ” to reflect the source “ché”. Target Text: ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದಿತ್ತು.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check Verify each Step4 line vs Reference Translation + Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within the line; re-insert only Step4 Missing; fix function-word/morphology anywhere; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation rule: do NOT introduce new internal punctuation; only keep the end punctuation transferred from the source line. Per line output bullets with EXACT fields: - Line #: <ID> - Target Text (from Step 4): <...> - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): <...> - Reference Translation (line-aligned): <...> - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> - If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text: <...> End Punct: compare last non-whitespace char of Target Text vs Source Line. Line # rule: <ID> is the leading integer at the start of that Source Line. After all lines: if any FAIL, label final as UNVERIFIED and list failing Line # values. Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line.

- Line #: 1 Target Text (from Step 4): ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ Back-Translation (literal into English): road in the middle of our life Reference Translation (line‑aligned): Midway upon the road of our life Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 2 Target Text (from Step 4): ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲೇ ತಾನೇ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ, Back-Translation (literal into English): I myself found in the dark forest, Reference Translation (line‑aligned): I found myself within a dark wood, Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 3 Target Text (from Step 4): ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದಿತ್ತು. Back-Translation (literal into English): because the correct path was lost. Reference Translation (line‑aligned): for the right way had been missed. Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
**Verification Status:** VERIFIED
```kannada ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲೇ ತಾನೇ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದಿತ್ತು. ```
